name: What are the common styles or orientations for installing shiplap?

mainEntity.name: What are the common styles or orientations for installing shiplap?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shiplap can be installed in various orientations to achieve different visual effects, offering flexibility in design. The most common styles include horizontal, vertical, and diagonal. Horizontal installation tends to make a room feel wider and more expansive, drawing the eye across the space. Vertical shiplap can make ceilings appear higher and add a sense of formality. Diagonal installation, while more labor-intensive, creates a dynamic, custom look that can be a strong focal point. The choice of orientation is a decision factor that significantly impacts the perceived dimensions and overall aesthetic of your room. We can discuss which orientation best suits your design goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common shiplap orientations include horizontal (makes rooms feel wider), vertical (makes ceilings appear higher), and diagonal (dynamic accent). The choice of orientation significantly impacts a room's perceived dimensions and aesthetic.
